faq.q: What plan guides development in Brentwood?
faq.a: Brentwood is one of four Town Centres designated in Burnaby's Official Community Plan; the Brentwood Town Centre Development Plan (1996) is the community plan, and the Brentwood Site at Lougheed Highway and Willingdon Avenue is guided by the Brentwood Site Conceptual Master Plan adopted in 2013.
